Characters.NotebookIntro: Chief executive of Vale Tower. The nameplate says so. Nothing on it says where the hour went.
Characters.VoiceNote: Low, controlled, used to being the last person to speak.

Characters.NotebookIntro: A student. She was in the lobby before midnight with papers that needed a signature.
Characters.VoiceNote: Young, careful, out of breath when she is afraid of being late.

Characters.NotebookIntro: A detective. His byline is on the evening paper in the boardroom.
Characters.VoiceNote: Dry, observational, tired of lies that waste the night.

Characters.NotebookIntro: A doctor. Her name is on a waiver in the desk.
Characters.VoiceNote: Precise, quiet, the voice of someone who has already given the warning.

Characters.NotebookIntro: A photographer. His name is not in this office.
Characters.VoiceNote: Light, already halfway out of the room.

Characters.NotebookIntro: A chef. His name is not in this office.
Characters.VoiceNote: Warm, crowded, talking over the kitchen.

Characters.NotebookIntro: An athlete. Her name is not in this office.
Characters.VoiceNote: Short sentences. Breath kept for the next effort.

Characters.NotebookIntro: A public voice. Her name is not in this office.
Characters.VoiceNote: Bright, performed, a half-second delay as if she is hearing herself.

Characters.NotebookIntro: A scientist. His name is not in this office.
Characters.VoiceNote: Measured. He corrects his own units.

Characters.NotebookIntro: The name on the back of an unfinished canvas.
Characters.VoiceNote: Slow, certain about pictures and uncertain about dates.

Characters.NotebookIntro: A silhouette. No face. No name. He does not explain himself.
Characters.VoiceNote: Deep. Calm. Restrained. Almost compassionate. Never cartoonishly evil.
